text: I think you'll really enjoy this Mexican Scrambled Eggs recipe. As a vegetarian looking to boost your protein intake, this dish delivers with 23 grams of protein per serving. The black beans are a great source of plant-based protein, and the eggs provide an additional boost. The recipe also meets your time budget, ready in just 10 minutes. Plus, you get to enjoy the flavors of Mexico with the salsa, cilantro, and cream cheese. This recipe should fit your dietary needs and preferences perfectly.
